facebookresearch_nerf-det/mmdet3d/mmcv/v.create_VideoReader: create a VideoReader instance to open a video file and access frames by index or iteration

facebookresearch_nerf-det/mmdet3d/mmcv/v.dequantize_flow: recover a float32 optical flow array from quantized dx and dy uint8 components
facebookresearch_nerf-det/mmdet3d/mmcv/v.warp_image_with_flow: warp an image using an optical flow field with nearest or bilinear interpolation via flow_warp

facebookresearch_nerf-det/mmdet3d/mmcv/v.resize_video_dimensions: resize a video to a specific width and height or scale ratio with ffmpeg
facebookresearch_nerf-det/mmdet3d/mmcv/v.cut_video_clip: cut a clip from a video by specifying start and end time in seconds
facebookresearch_nerf-det/mmdet3d/mmcv/v.concat_video_list: concatenate multiple video files into a single output video using ffmpeg
facebookresearch_nerf-det/mmdet3d/mmcv/v.review_processing_functions: review the video processing module functions for ffmpeg conversion, resizing, cutting, and concatenation
